youtube.title: A Black Friday poster where $89 stays $89: exact text, exported to PNG, SVG and PDF
youtube.description:
A Black Friday poster where $89 stays $89.
Every word comes from a copy deck and the text audit checks it byte for byte; the poster exports to PNG, SVG and PDF, and the PDF is still sharp zoomed 12x. GLOWMOP is a fictional brand. This Short rendered in under 40 seconds on a 4-core CPU with no GPU.
Free, open source, runs locally: https://github.com/IsraelWebDev/funkbox
Made with funkbox.
